installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# CyberMP server install script
# Installer is Ubuntu 22.04, same base as the official CyberMP Docker image
set -e

REPO="Cyber-MP/CyberMP-Server-Releases"

## Runtime dependencies (same set as the official Dockerfile)
echo "deb http://security.ubuntu.com/ubuntu focal-security main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/focal-security.list
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libssl1.1 libnng1 libc-ares2 libatomic1 libcurl3-gnutls

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

## Resolve release
if [ -z "${SERVER_VERSION}" ] || [ "${SERVER_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    RELEASE_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases/latest"
else
    TAG="${SERVER_VERSION}"
    if [[ "${TAG}" != v* ]]; then
        TAG="v${TAG}"
    fi
    RELEASE_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases/tags/${TAG}"
fi

echo "Resolving release from ${RELEASE_URL}"
DOWNLOAD_URL=$(curl -fsSL "${RELEASE_URL}" | jq -r '.assets[] | select((.name | startswith("cybermp-server-linux-build")) and (.name | endswith(".zip"))) | .browser_download_url' | head -n 1)

if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] || [ "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" = "null" ]; then
    echo "Could not find a Linux server build for version '${SERVER_VERSION}'"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Downloading ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
curl -fsSL -o cybermp-server.zip "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

## Keep the user's config across reinstalls/updates
if [ -f server.toml ]; then
    mv server.toml server.toml.keep
fi

unzip -o -q cybermp-server.zip
rm -f cybermp-server.zip

if [ -f server.toml.keep ]; then
    mv -f server.toml.keep server.toml
fi

mkdir -p resources

if [ ! -f server.toml ]; then
    echo "Downloading default server.toml"
    curl -fsSL -o server.toml "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${REPO}/main/server.toml"
fi

## Upstream default still uses the old key name
sed -i 's/^disable_VoIP_server/disable_voice/' server.toml

chmod +x cybermp-server
if [ -f bin/crashpad_handler ]; then
    chmod +x bin/crashpad_handler
fi

## Bundle shared libraries into ./libs so the stock yolk image can run the server.
## glibc, libstdc++ and libgcc_s are provided (newer) by the runtime image.
if ldd ./cybermp-server | grep -q "not found"; then
    echo "Missing libraries:"
    ldd ./cybermp-server | grep "not found"
    exit 1
fi

rm -rf libs
mkdir -p libs
for BIN in ./cybermp-server ./bin/crashpad_handler; do
    if [ -f "${BIN}" ]; then
        ldd "${BIN}" | awk '$2 == "=>" {print $3}' | grep '^/' || true
    fi
done | sort -u | while read -r LIB; do
    case "$(basename "${LIB}")" in
        libc.so.*|libm.so.*|libdl.so.*|libpthread.so.*|librt.so.*|libresolv.so.*|ld-linux*|libstdc++.so.*|libgcc_s.so.*)
            ;;
        *)
            cp -L "${LIB}" libs/
            ;;
    esac
done

echo "Bundled libraries:"
ls -1 libs

echo "CyberMP install complete"

variables.name: Server Version
variables.description: Release tag to install (e.g. v4.0.4-beta.1) or "latest". Reinstall the server to apply.

variables.name: Public Address
variables.description: Public IP or hostname clients use to connect (connection_host_addr). Port is added automatically. Defaults to 127.0.0.1 when empty.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum number of concurrent player slots.

variables.name: Masterlist Token
variables.description: Masterlist server token (private_token). Leave empty for private/local servers.

variables.name: Disable Voice
variables.description: Disable the built-in 3D positional VoIP server.

variables.name: Phantom Liberty DLC
variables.description: Enable content from the Phantom Liberty expansion (ep2_dlc_enabled).
